home.title: Put this device to work
home.subtitle: Enroll it into a pool and it will serve models for your organisation.
home.modelNone: No model assigned to the pool

blocked.not-enrolled: Enroll this device to start serving.
blocked.not-approved: Waiting for an admin to approve this device.
blocked.no-gateway: The platform has not given this device a gateway yet.

enroll.title: Enroll this device
enroll.intro: In the web app, open a pool and choose Add device, then type the code shown or scan its QR.
enroll.noCamera: Camera access is off. You can still type the code.
enroll.urlHint: The SplitCortex server (control plane). Change it only for a self-hosted or local setup.

errors.invalidCode: This code is not valid, has expired or was already used.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.untrustedServer: The server could not prove it knows this code. Check the URL and the code.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check the URL and your connection.
errors.server: The server returned an unexpected answer.

status.forgetNote: Removes the enrollment from this device only. Revoke the device in the web app too.

logs.note: What the node is doing. Prompts and answers are never logged.

settings.startAtBootHint: Android only. The background service starts after boot with no need to open the app, and keeps serving with the screen off.
settings.connectOnStart: Connect and load the model on start
settings.connectOnStartHint: When the app starts, connect to the gateway and load the pool's model automatically.

compute.label: Compute
compute.hint: Automatic measures CPU and GPU once for each model and picks the faster. An administrator can override this per device from the web app.

context.label: Context window (tokens)
context.hint: Prompt, history and answer together. Larger needs more memory; automatic follows the device's RAM. An administrator can override this from the web app.
context.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave empty for automatic.

settings.keepScreenOnHint: Some Android devices only run the GPU at full speed while the app is open in the foreground with the display on. Turns the display's sleep off while the app is open; keep the app open and the device charging. An admin can override this from the web app.
settings.enableMtpHint: Speeds up generation on models that ship a drafter (such as Gemma 4) by predicting several tokens at once. Ignored for models without one. Reloads the model. An admin can override this from the web app.

battery.title: Keep running in the background
battery.hint: Android may freeze the network of an app that runs in the background (Doze), which drops the connection to the gateway while the screen is off. Allow this app to ignore battery optimisation so the device keeps serving.
battery.ok: Battery optimisation is off for this app: it can keep serving in the background.
